Embedding benchmark · Apple M5 Max, 128 GB · 11 Oct 2026

EmbeddingGemma 2 vs Gemini Embedding 2

Can a free model running on this Mac replace Google's cloud embedding API? We ran 19 tests across eight departments, from code search to Malayalam voice queries, with both models on identical inputs. EmbeddingGemma 2 is the open model running locally. Gemini Embedding 2 is the paid API.

google/embeddinggemma-2 · 740M params · 768dgemini-embedding-2 · 3072d~80,000 texts, 1,000 photos, 60 video clips, 43 PDF pages, 1,323 audio clips per modelCloud spend ~$5 (est.)Code and data on GitHub
VerdictTest benchScoreboardBy departmentMediaVector sizeSpeed and costWhat to use whenExtended testsDo we need it?PrivacyNot coveredSourcesMethodReproduceLive modSource codeLogs

Verdict

4tests the local model wins
6tests the cloud model wins
8ties (gap under 3 points)
1neither model is usable

For English text, code, photos and PDFs, you don't need the cloud. The local model wins or ties 12 of 19 tests, answers a query in 13 ms against 617 ms, costs nothing per document and keeps every file on the machine.

Pay for Gemini Embedding 2 when any of these apply:

  • You search in Urdu, Arabic, Tamil or Malayalam (local is 9 to 18 points behind on those languages).
  • You match questions to written answers in finance or developer support (finance: 0.508 local vs 0.719 cloud).
  • You search sound effects, or let people search photos by speaking Hindi or Arabic.
  • One index mixes photos and text, and you add the per-type calibration described below.

If you choose the cloud for text only, test Gemini Embedding 1 as well. The older model beat Gemini Embedding 2 on finance, legal and languages in our runs.

Whatever you pick, chunk long documents. A relevant passage in the middle of a 2,000-token document drops search quality by more than half for both models.

Skip embeddings entirely for judging resume fit (both models score close to a coin flip), and consider plain keyword search for near-duplicate detection, where it scores 0.975.

By department

Engineering

mixed

Code search from a docstring is a near-tie (0.956 vs 0.969), and both crush keyword search (0.636). For matching a developer's question to a written answer, the cloud is clearly better (0.898 vs 0.983).

Support and sales

tie

Routing tickets to 77 intents: 91.6% local, 93.2% cloud, with 16 examples per intent. Duplicate questions: both 0.99. Similarity scoring favours local (0.875 vs 0.771 Spearman).

Finance

cloud

The biggest gap in the study. Matching investor questions to answers: 0.508 local vs 0.719 cloud nDCG@10, with keyword search at 0.414. Recall@10 is 59.6% vs 80.2%.

Legal

local

Finding the contract clause that answers a consumer question: local 0.771, cloud 0.732, keyword 0.711. The local model also holds up far better when vectors are shrunk to 128 (0.716 vs 0.595).

HR

neither

Scoring whether a resume fits a job description: ROC-AUC 0.576 local, 0.504 cloud, where 0.5 is a coin flip. Similarity between a resume and a job ad does not capture fit. Use an LLM with a scoring rubric instead.

Science and health

cloud

Claims to evidence (SciFact): 0.853 vs 0.896. Lay health questions to medical research (NFCorpus): 0.354 vs 0.427. The cloud is 4 to 7 points ahead on both.

Languages

cloud

Matching a sentence to its English translation among 1,000 candidates. Hindi and French are close; Urdu (77.2% vs 94.9%), Malayalam, Arabic and Tamil favour the cloud by 9 to 18 points.

Field and media

mixed

Photo search and voice notes are close to a tie. PDF pages favour local. Sound effects and non-English spoken queries favour the cloud. Details below.

Photos, voice, sounds and PDFs

Photo library search

1,000 Flickr30k photos, each searched with its five human-written captions (5,000 queries). The local model finds the right photo first 86.8% of the time and in the top five 97.9%; the cloud model scores 88.9% and 98.2%. The 2-point gap is statistically real but small in practice.

TestLocal 768dLocal 256dLocal 128dCloud 768dCloud 256dCloud 128d
Text → photo, R@186.8%84.9%76.4%88.9%80.9%64.6%
Text → photo, R@597.9%97.4%92.9%98.2%95.6%85.9%
Photo → caption, R@194.3%––96.6%––

At 128 dimensions the local model keeps 76.4% R@1 and the cloud model drops to 64.6%. The 270M text-only build of the local model produced the same query vectors as the full model (cosine ≥ 0.9961) and the same R@1, so you can index photos with the full model on a server and search them from a phone with the small one.

Search photos in six languages, typed and spoken

50 captions translated into German, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic and Malayalam, then spoken with macOS voices (English, Hindi "Lekha", Arabic "Majed"). The audio goes straight into each model with no transcription.

Mixed indexes lean towards the query's own file type. With 1,000 photos and 1,000 captions in one index, a photo query in the cloud model ranked every other photo above its own caption (median rank 1000). The local model put the caption at median #4, and in the top 10 for 72.7% of photos. Text queries returned only 11.8% (local) and 6.2% (cloud) photos in their top 10. A community demo reported the same effect. If one index holds several file types, score each type separately or calibrate per type; with the cloud model this is mandatory.

Long documents: where the answer sits matters

Each SciFact document was padded to about five abstracts (1,500 to 2,000 tokens) with the relevant one placed first, in the middle, or last.

Relevant passageLocal nDCG@10Cloud nDCG@10
Alone (short document)0.9220.951
At the start0.7430.691
In the middle0.3310.317
At the end0.3110.337

Both models summarise a long input into one vector, so a passage buried in the middle of a long document is mostly lost. Chunk documents into passages of a few hundred tokens before embedding. That matters more than which model you pick.

Fixing the file-type bias

Mixed index of 1,000 photos and 1,000 captions. "Calibrated" standardises each query's scores within each file type before merging the lists.

QueryModelPhotos in top 10, raw → calibratedR@1, raw → calibrated
Text (photo or caption is correct)EmbeddingGemma 211.8% → 41.6%80.4% → 88.3%
Photo (its caption is correct)EmbeddingGemma 291.2% → 52.6%23.9% → 79.7%
Text (photo or caption is correct)Gemini Embedding 26.2% → 56.1%74.7% → 93.2%
Photo (its caption is correct)Gemini Embedding 2100.0% → 56.0%0.0% → 78.4%

A few lines of code fix most of the bias. With calibration the cloud model becomes the better choice for mixed photo-and-text search; without it, its photo queries never find text.

The older cloud model beats the new one on text. Gemini Embedding 1 scored higher than Gemini Embedding 2 on finance (0.787 vs 0.719), legal (0.804 vs 0.732) and five of six languages (tied on the sixth). Gemini Embedding 2's advantage is multimodal input. For a text-only workload, test both. Among open models of this size, EmbeddingGemma 2 beats Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B clearly on science claims, legal and every language, and is level elsewhere (Qwen3 edges ahead on medical and developer Q&A by under half a point).

Search speed depends only on vector size and the index, not on which model made the vectors, so 256d is also three times cheaper to search exactly. The 1M timings use random unit vectors on this Mac's CPU under load; recall is measured on real vectors, because random data is a worst case for approximate indexes. The 4-bit build loses almost nothing and fits in 176 MB.

Do we really need it?

Do we need embeddings at all?

For near-duplicate questions, keyword search scored 0.975 against 0.99 for both models, so start there. Everywhere else embeddings pay off: code search 0.636 → 0.956, claims to evidence 0.686 → 0.853, developer answers 0.725 → 0.898.

Do we need the cloud?

Only for the cases in the decision chart: under-served languages, finance and support answer search, sound effects and non-English speech. That is 6 of 19 tests. Everything else runs free on the laptop.

Do we need 3072 dimensions?

No. The cloud's 3072d adds at most 0.01 nDCG over 768d and quadruples storage. 256d loses about 2 points for either model.

Do we need the full local model?

Not for searching. The 270M text-only build gives identical query vectors, so index photos and audio once with the full 740M model, then query with the small one on any device.

Do we need a GPU?

Not for queries: the 4-bit build answers in about 31 ms on 4 CPU threads. A GPU matters for bulk indexing, especially images (about 4 per second here on PyTorch).

Do we need a vector database?

Not below about a million documents. Exact search over 1M vectors at 256d took 24.8 ms per query on this CPU. Above that, an HNSW index answers in under a millisecond and found 97.7% of the exact top 10 on real vectors.

Do we need hybrid search?

Only for some corpora. Adding keyword search lifted legal and the local model's finance and medical scores, but lowered code and science search. Measure it on your data first.

Do we need to fine-tune?

For Malayalam, Urdu or Arabic speech, or a narrow domain like finance, fine-tuning the open model is the way to close the gap without paying per call. The weights are Apache 2.0.

Method and caveats

  1. Same inputs: both models embed exactly the same texts, images and audio, truncated at 16,000 characters. Each gets its documented task prompt: a text prefix for EmbeddingGemma 2, a task_type for Gemini.
  2. Large corpora are sampled: for FiQA, Quora and StackOverflow we kept every relevant document for 300 sampled queries and filled to 8,000 to 10,000 documents with random distractors (seeded). The keyword baseline reproduces the same samples.
  3. Statistics: per-query scores for both models, 2,000 paired bootstrap resamples, 95% interval. A gap counts as a win only if the interval excludes zero and the gap is at least 3 points.
  4. Contamination: these are public datasets, and either model may have seen them in training. That inflates absolute scores (SciFact is unusually high for both); the comparison between models is the useful part. Test on your own data before committing.
  5. Synthetic inputs: spoken queries come from macOS text-to-speech, and the five translations came from Gemini 3.5 Flash. Real accents and noise will be harder.
  6. Small samples: PDF pages (18 queries) and voice notes (73 clips) have no confidence interval. Treat them as directional.
  7. Similarity scoring: the cloud model scored 0.77 Spearman on STS-B with its SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY task type, lower than expected. We did not tune task types beyond the documented ones.
  8. Shared machine: load average went above 200 during the run, mostly from a browser and endpoint security software, so local throughput figures are a floor.

What this benchmark does not cover

  • Your own documents. Public datasets can be in either model's training data; a small labelled sample of your own content is the test that matters.
  • Noisy real-world audio such as phone calls or messaging-app voice notes. FLEURS is clean read speech.
  • Fine-tuning. The open model can be fine-tuned on your data; the cloud model cannot.
  • Cloud rate limits, error rates and multi-day stability. Our runs saw no failed requests, but we did not stress the quota.
  • A phone. CPU-only timings on this Mac stand in for on-device numbers.
  • Rerankers and chunking strategies beyond the long-document test.

Reproduce

Everything is in the public repository github.com/shivanathd/embeddinggemma2-vs-gemini-bench, including every result file and log behind this page. It runs on an Apple Silicon Mac with no admin rights. Embeddings are cached, so a re-run only recomputes scores.

git clone https://github.com/shivanathd/embeddinggemma2-vs-gemini-bench
cd embeddinggemma2-vs-gemini-bench
python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install jinja2 numpy   # enough to rebuild this page
.venv/bin/python build_report.py report/index.html            # from the committed results

# Full re-run on an Apple Silicon Mac (~3-5 h, ~$5 of Gemini usage)
scripts/setup.sh                      # env, llama.cpp, models, PDFs, video, FLEURS, spoken queries
export GOOGLE_API_KEY=...             # a Gemini API key
scripts/run_all.sh                    # every suite in the required order, then rebuilds report/index.html
FileWhat it does
bench.pyShared helpers: local model loader, cloud batching (100 per call, one Content per item), truncation
suite_text.pyRetrieval, classification, similarity, HR fit and translation tests with bootstrap intervals
suite_media.pyPhoto, multilingual, spoken, sound, voice-note, PDF and latency tests
suite_bm25.py · suite_speed.pyKeyword baseline · speed and concurrency
suite_more.py · ann_scale.pyHybrid, long documents, bias fix, mixed inputs, duplicates, clustering, real voices, video, other models, 4-bit and CPU builds · scale
results/*.json · logs/*.logEvery number on this page, and the raw run output
.archify/Diagram sources (JSON) and interactive HTML for both figures

Watching it run: the bench-watch mod

A Claude Code mod (a plugin that adds to Claude Code's own interface) showed the benchmark live while it ran: which suites were running, the newest line of each log, a local-vs-cloud scoreboard that filled in as results landed, system load, and the tool calls Claude was making. It also adds a one-line summary to the status line and a /bench command to reopen the pane.

How it works

Every 3 seconds the mod reads logs/*.log and results/*.json, lists running processes and reads the load average, then redraws the pane. A tool.call hook records each tool Claude runs. It never blocks a tool: its bookkeeping errors are swallowed.

Install

Copy the five bench-watch/ files below into a folder, then start Claude Code with claude --plugin-dir ./bench-watch. Check it with claude plugin validate ./bench-watch and claude plugin test ./bench-watch. Point the paths at your own benchmark folder.

Source code

Every script used for this report, in full. The only edits are for publication: the line that loaded the author's API key now asserts GOOGLE_API_KEY is set, and personal paths are replaced with ~. Requirements: Python 3.13 with sentence-transformers>=6.1, transformers>=5, torch, google-genai, datasets, scikit-learn, scipy, bm25s, PyStemmer, faiss-cpu, soundfile, jinja2; llama.cpp b11541; ffmpeg and pdftoppm.

bench.py · 164 lines · Shared helpers: local model loader, cloud batching (one Content per item, 100 per call), first benchmark
"""EmbeddingGemma 2 (local, Apple Silicon) vs gemini-embedding-2 (cloud).

Usage: .venv/bin/python bench.py [text|image|all]
"""
import io, json, os, sys, time, statistics as st
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import numpy as np, torch
from datasets import load_dataset

assert os.environ.get("GOOGLE_API_KEY"), "Set GOOGLE_API_KEY (a Gemini API key) before running"
from google import genai
from google.genai import types

CACHE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "cache"); os.makedirs(CACHE, exist_ok=True)
DIMS = (768, 512, 256, 128)
gc = genai.Client()


def norm(x): return x / np.linalg.norm(x, axis=1, keepdims=True)
def trunc(x, d): return norm(x[:, :d])
def ms(xs): return f"p50 {st.median(xs)*1000:.0f} ms, p95 {np.percentile(xs, 95)*1000:.0f} ms"


def cached(name, fn):
    p = os.path.join(CACHE, name + ".npy")
    if os.path.exists(p): return np.load(p), None
    t = time.time(); v = fn(); dt = time.time() - t
    np.save(p, v); return v, dt


def load_local(**cfg):
    from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
    return SentenceTransformer("google/embeddinggemma-2", device="mps",
                               model_kwargs={"dtype": torch.bfloat16}, config_kwargs=cfg)


def cloud_embed(parts, task=None, dim=3072, model="gemini-embedding-2"):
    """parts: list of str or types.Part. One embedding per item (each wrapped in its own Content)."""
    cfg = types.EmbedContentConfig(task_type=task, output_dimensionality=dim)

    def call(chunk):
        for attempt in range(6):
            try:
                r = gc.models.embed_content(model=model, config=cfg,
                    contents=[types.Content(parts=[p if isinstance(p, types.Part) else types.Part(text=p)]) for p in chunk])
                return [e.values for e in r.embeddings]
            except Exception as e:
                if attempt == 5: raise
                time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
    chunks = [parts[i:i + 100] for i in range(0, len(parts), 100)]
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(8) as ex:
        out = [v for c in ex.map(call, chunks) for v in c]
    return norm(np.array(out, dtype=np.float32))


def ndcg10(Q, D, qids, dids, qrels):
    S = Q @ D.T; top = np.argsort(-S, axis=1)[:, :10]; out = []
    for i, q in enumerate(qids):
        rel = qrels[q]
        dcg = sum(1 / np.log2(r + 2) for r, j in enumerate(top[i]) if dids[j] in rel)
        idcg = sum(1 / np.log2(r + 2) for r in range(min(len(rel), 10)))
        out.append(dcg / idcg)
    return float(np.mean(out))


def text_bench():
    print("\n=== TEXT: SciFact (BEIR) ===")
    corpus = load_dataset("mteb/scifact", "corpus")["corpus"]
    queries = {r["_id"]: r["text"] for r in load_dataset("mteb/scifact", "queries")["queries"]}
    qrels = {}
    for r in load_dataset("mteb/scifact", "default")["test"]:
        if r["score"] > 0: qrels.setdefault(str(r["query-id"]), set()).add(str(r["corpus-id"]))
    qids = sorted(qrels); dids = [str(x) for x in corpus["_id"]]
    qtext = [queries[q] for q in qids]
    print(f"{len(dids)} docs, {len(qids)} queries")

    m = load_local(vision_config=None, audio_config=None)  # text-only = 270M
    m.encode(["warmup"] * 8, prompt_name="SearchQuery")
    loc_docs = [f"title: {t or 'none'} | text: {x}" for t, x in zip(corpus["title"], corpus["text"])]
    LD, ldt = cached("loc_scifact_docs", lambda: m.encode(loc_docs, batch_size=32, normalize_embeddings=True))
    LQ, _ = cached("loc_scifact_q", lambda: m.encode(qtext, prompt_name="SearchQuery", normalize_embeddings=True))
    cloud_docs = [f"{t}\n{x}" if t else x for t, x in zip(corpus["title"], corpus["text"])]
    CD, cdt = cached("cloud_scifact_docs", lambda: cloud_embed(cloud_docs, "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT"))
    CQ, _ = cached("cloud_scifact_q", lambda: cloud_embed(qtext, "RETRIEVAL_QUERY"))

    print("\nnDCG@10 by dimension:")
    print(f"{'dim':>6} {'EmbeddingGemma2':>16} {'gemini-emb-2':>14}")
    for d in (3072, 1536) + DIMS:
        l = f"{ndcg10(trunc(LQ, d), trunc(LD, d), qids, dids, qrels):.4f}" if d <= 768 else "-"
        print(f"{d:>6} {l:>16} {ndcg10(trunc(CQ, d), trunc(CD, d), qids, dids, qrels):>14.4f}")

    if ldt: print(f"\nIndexing {len(dids)} docs: local {ldt:.1f}s ({len(dids)/ldt:.0f} docs/s)")
    if cdt: print(f"Indexing {len(dids)} docs: cloud {cdt:.1f}s ({len(dids)/cdt:.0f} docs/s, 8 parallel x 100/req)")
    nchar = sum(map(len, cloud_docs)); print(f"Corpus ~{nchar/4/1e6:.2f}M tokens -> cloud cost ~${nchar/4/1e6*0.20:.2f} (at $0.20/1M)")

    sample = qtext[:40]
    lat = []
    for q in sample:
        t = time.perf_counter(); m.encode(q, prompt_name="SearchQuery"); torch.mps.synchronize(); lat.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
    print(f"\nSingle-query latency local (MPS bf16): {ms(lat)}")
    mc = load_local(vision_config=None, audio_config=None).to("cpu").float()
    mc.encode("warmup"); lat = []
    for q in sample[:20]:
        t = time.perf_counter(); mc.encode(q, prompt_name="SearchQuery"); lat.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
    print(f"Single-query latency local (CPU fp32): {ms(lat)}")
    lat = []
    for q in sample[:20]:
        t = time.perf_counter(); cloud_embed([q], "RETRIEVAL_QUERY", 768); lat.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
    print(f"Single-query latency cloud:            {ms(lat)}")
    t = time.perf_counter(); s = LQ @ LD.T; np.argsort(-s, axis=1)
    print(f"Brute-force search {len(qids)}x{len(dids)} @768d: {(time.perf_counter()-t)*1000:.0f} ms total")


def image_bench(n=300):
    print(f"\n=== IMAGE: Flickr30k test, {n} images ===")
    rows = list(load_dataset("lmms-lab/flickr30k", split="test", streaming=True).take(n))
    imgs = [r["image"].convert("RGB") for r in rows]
    cap0 = [r["caption"][0] for r in rows]  # in the corpus
    cap1 = [r["caption"][1] for r in rows]  # used as query

    m = load_local(audio_config=None)  # text+vision = 440M
    m.encode([{"image": imgs[0]}])
    LI, lit = cached(f"loc_img{n}", lambda: m.encode([{"image": im} for im in imgs], batch_size=8, normalize_embeddings=True))
    LC, _ = cached(f"loc_cap0_{n}", lambda: m.encode(cap0, prompt_name="Document", normalize_embeddings=True))
    LQ, _ = cached(f"loc_cap1_{n}", lambda: m.encode(cap1, prompt_name="SearchQuery", normalize_embeddings=True))

    def jpg(im):
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=90); return types.Part.from_bytes(data=b.getvalue(), mime_type="image/jpeg")
    CI, cit = cached(f"cloud_img{n}", lambda: cloud_embed([jpg(im) for im in imgs], "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT", 768))
    CC, _ = cached(f"cloud_cap0_{n}", lambda: cloud_embed(cap0, "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT", 768))
    CQ, _ = cached(f"cloud_cap1_{n}", lambda: cloud_embed(cap1, "RETRIEVAL_QUERY", 768))

    def recall(S, k): return float(np.mean([i in np.argsort(-S[i])[:k] for i in range(n)]))
    def report(name, Q, I, C):
        print(f"\n[{name}]")
        S = Q @ I.T; print(f"  text->image  R@1 {recall(S,1):.3f}  R@5 {recall(S,5):.3f}")
        S = I @ C.T; print(f"  image->text  R@1 {recall(S,1):.3f}  R@5 {recall(S,5):.3f}")
        # Modality bias: mixed corpus of n images + n captions.
        M = np.vstack([I, C]); is_img = np.r_[np.ones(n, bool), np.zeros(n, bool)]
        top = np.argsort(-(Q @ M.T), axis=1)[:, :10]
        print(f"  text query, mixed corpus: top-10 that are images {is_img[top].mean():.0%} (fair = 50%)")
        Sx = I @ M.T; Sx[np.arange(n), np.arange(n)] = -9  # drop the query image itself
        top = np.argsort(-Sx, axis=1)[:, :10]
        own_cap_rank = [int(np.where(np.argsort(-Sx[i]) == n + i)[0][0]) + 1 for i in range(n)]
        print(f"  image query, mixed corpus: top-10 that are images {is_img[top].mean():.0%}; "
              f"its own caption ranks median #{int(np.median(own_cap_rank))}, in top-10 {np.mean(np.array(own_cap_rank)<=10):.0%}")
    report("EmbeddingGemma 2 local @768", LQ, LI, LC)
    report("gemini-embedding-2 cloud @768", CQ, CI, CC)
    if lit: print(f"\nImage indexing local: {n/lit:.1f} img/s")
    if cit: print(f"Image indexing cloud: {n/cit:.1f} img/s")
    lat = []
    for im in imgs[:15]:
        t = time.perf_counter(); m.encode([{"image": im}]); torch.mps.synchronize(); lat.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
    print(f"Single image-query latency local: {ms(lat)}")
    lat = []
    for im in imgs[:10]:
        t = time.perf_counter(); cloud_embed([jpg(im)], None, 768); lat.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
    print(f"Single image-query latency cloud: {ms(lat)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    which = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "all"
    if which in ("text", "all"): text_bench()
    if which in ("image", "all"): image_bench()
suite_text.py · 246 lines · 11 text tests with paired bootstrap intervals; Qwen3 and Gemini 1 branches
"""Text use-case suite: EmbeddingGemma 2 (llama.cpp Q8_0, local) vs gemini-embedding-2 (cloud).

Every task caches embeddings in cache/, writes metrics + paired-bootstrap CIs to results/text.json.
Usage: .venv/bin/python suite_text.py [task ...]
"""
import gzip, json, os, random, sys, time, urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from bench import cloud_embed, norm, trunc, CACHE

LLAMA = "http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/embeddings"
MAXCH = 16000  # ~4k tokens; applied to both models
RES = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "results", "text.json")
rng = random.Random(7)

P_LOCAL = {  # EmbeddingGemma 2 model-card prefixes
    "query": "task: search result | query: ", "code": "task: code retrieval | query: ",
    "qa": "task: question answering | query: ", "doc": "title: none | text: ",
    "cls": "task: classification | query: ", "sts": "task: sentence similarity | query: ",
}
QWEN = "http://127.0.0.1:8091/v1/embeddings"
P_QWEN = {  # Qwen3-Embedding: instruction on queries only, documents raw
    "query": "Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query\nQuery:",
    "code": "Instruct: Given a question, retrieve code or answers that solve it\nQuery:",
    "qa": "Instruct: Given a question, retrieve passages that answer it\nQuery:",
    "doc": "", "cls": "Instruct: Classify the intent of the customer message\nQuery:",
    "sts": "Instruct: Retrieve semantically similar text\nQuery:",
}
P_CLOUD = {"query": "RETRIEVAL_QUERY", "code": "CODE_RETRIEVAL_QUERY", "qa": "QUESTION_ANSWERING",
           "doc": "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT", "cls": "CLASSIFICATION", "sts": "SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY"}


def local_embed(texts, url=LLAMA):
    def call(chunk):
        body = json.dumps({"input": chunk}).encode()
        for a in range(5):
            try:
                r = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, body, {"content-type": "application/json"}), timeout=600)
                return [d["embedding"] for d in json.load(r)["data"]]
            except Exception:
                if a == 4: raise
                time.sleep(2)
    chunks = [texts[i:i + 16] for i in range(0, len(texts), 16)]
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(4) as ex:
        out = [v for c in ex.map(call, chunks) for v in c]
    return norm(np.array(out, np.float32))


def embed(name, model, texts, kind, title=None):
    """Cached embedding. Local gets a text prefix; cloud gets a task_type."""
    p = os.path.join(CACHE, f"{model}_{name}.npy")
    if os.path.exists(p): return np.load(p), None
    texts = [t[:MAXCH] for t in texts]
    t0 = time.time()
    if model == "loc":
        v = local_embed([P_LOCAL[kind] + t for t in texts])
    elif model == "qwen":
        v = local_embed([P_QWEN[kind] + t for t in texts], QWEN)
    elif model == "g1":
        v = cloud_embed([t if t.strip() else "(empty)" for t in texts], P_CLOUD[kind], model="gemini-embedding-001")
    else:
        v = cloud_embed([t if t.strip() else "(empty)" for t in texts], P_CLOUD[kind])
    dt = time.time() - t0
    np.save(p, v)
    print(f"  embedded {len(texts)} x {model} [{kind}] in {dt:.1f}s ({len(texts)/dt:.0f}/s)", flush=True)
    return v, dt


def boot(a, b, n=2000):
    """Paired bootstrap of mean(b) - mean(a): returns (diff, lo, hi)."""
    a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float); r = np.random.default_rng(0)
    idx = r.integers(0, len(a), (n, len(a)))
    d = b[idx].mean(1) - a[idx].mean(1)
    return float(b.mean() - a.mean()), float(np.percentile(d, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(d, 97.5))


def per_query_ndcg(Q, D, qids, dids, qrels, k=10):
    S = Q @ D.T; top = np.argsort(-S, axis=1)[:, :k]; nd, rr, rc = [], [], []
    for i, q in enumerate(qids):
        rel = qrels[q]; hits = [dids[j] in rel for j in top[i]]
        dcg = sum(1 / np.log2(r + 2) for r, h in enumerate(hits) if h)
        idcg = sum(1 / np.log2(r + 2) for r in range(min(len(rel), k)))
        nd.append(dcg / idcg); rr.append(next((1 / (r + 1) for r, h in enumerate(hits) if h), 0.0))
        rc.append(sum(hits) / min(len(rel), k))
    return np.array(nd), np.array(rr), np.array(rc)


def jsonl(repo, f):
    p = hf_hub_download(repo, f, repo_type="dataset"); op = gzip.open if f.endswith(".gz") else open
    with op(p, "rt") as fh: return [json.loads(l) for l in fh]


def pq(repo, f): return pd.read_parquet(hf_hub_download(repo, f, repo_type="dataset"))


def load_beir(repo, split="test", parquet_prefix=None):
    if parquet_prefix is None:
        corpus = {r["_id"]: ((r.get("title") or "") + "\n" + r["text"]).strip() for r in jsonl(repo, "corpus.jsonl")}
        queries = {r["_id"]: r["text"] for r in jsonl(repo, "queries.jsonl")}
        qr = jsonl(repo, f"qrels/{split}.jsonl")
    else:
        c = pq(repo, f"{parquet_prefix}corpus/test-00000-of-00001.parquet")
        idc = "_id" if "_id" in c else "id"
        corpus = {str(i): ((t or "") + "\n" + x).strip() for i, t, x in zip(c[idc], c["title"], c["text"])}
        qd = pq(repo, f"{parquet_prefix}queries/test-00000-of-00001.parquet")
        queries = {str(i): t for i, t in zip(qd["_id" if "_id" in qd else "id"], qd["text"])}
        qr = pq(repo, f"{parquet_prefix}qrels/test-00000-of-00001.parquet").to_dict("records")
    qrels = {}
    for r in qr:
        if float(r["score"]) > 0: qrels.setdefault(str(r["query-id"]), set()).add(str(r["corpus-id"]))
    return corpus, queries, qrels


def retrieval(name, repo, use_case, qkind="query", max_q=300, max_docs=None, **kw):
    corpus, queries, qrels = load_beir(repo, **kw)
    qids = sorted(q for q in qrels if q in queries)
    rng.shuffle(qids); qids = sorted(qids[:max_q])
    if max_docs and len(corpus) > max_docs:  # keep every judged doc, fill with random distractors
        keep = {d for q in qids for d in qrels[q] if d in corpus}
        rest = [d for d in corpus if d not in keep]; rng.shuffle(rest)
        keep |= set(rest[:max_docs - len(keep)])
        corpus = {d: corpus[d] for d in sorted(keep)}
    qrels = {q: {d for d in qrels[q] if d in corpus} for q in qids}
    qids = [q for q in qids if qrels[q]]
    dids = list(corpus)
    print(f"[{name}] {len(dids)} docs, {len(qids)} queries", flush=True)
    out = {"use_case": use_case, "dataset": repo, "docs": len(dids), "queries": len(qids), "metric": "nDCG@10"}
    E = {}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        D, ddt = embed(f"{name}_docs", m, [corpus[d] for d in dids], "doc")
        Q, _ = embed(f"{name}_q", m, [queries[q] for q in qids], qkind)
        E[m] = (Q, D)
        if ddt: out[f"{m}_index_docs_per_s"] = round(len(dids) / ddt, 1)
    for d in (768, 512, 256, 128):
        for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
            nd, rr, rc = per_query_ndcg(trunc(E[m][0], d), trunc(E[m][1], d), qids, dids, qrels)
            out[f"{m}_{d}"] = {"ndcg10": round(nd.mean(), 4), "mrr10": round(rr.mean(), 4), "recall10": round(rc.mean(), 4)}
            if d == 768: out[f"_pq_{m}"] = nd
    nd, _, _ = per_query_ndcg(E["cloud"][0], E["cloud"][1], qids, dids, qrels)
    out["cloud_3072"] = {"ndcg10": round(nd.mean(), 4)}
    out["diff_768"] = boot(out.pop("_pq_loc"), out.pop("_pq_cloud"))
    return out


def banking77():
    tr = pq("mteb/banking77", "data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet"); te = pq("mteb/banking77", "data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet")
    tr = tr.groupby("label").sample(16, random_state=7)
    te = te.sample(1000, random_state=7)
    print(f"[banking77] train {len(tr)} (16/intent), test {len(te)}", flush=True)
    out = {"use_case": "Support ticket routing (77 intents)", "dataset": "mteb/banking77", "metric": "accuracy",
           "train": len(tr), "test": len(te)}
    acc = {}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        Xtr, _ = embed("b77_train", m, tr.text.tolist(), "cls"); Xte, _ = embed("b77_test", m, te.text.tolist(), "cls")
        for d in (768, 256):
            clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000).fit(trunc(Xtr, d), tr.label)
            ok = clf.predict(trunc(Xte, d)) == te.label.values
            out[f"{m}_{d}"] = {"accuracy": round(ok.mean(), 4)}
            if d == 768: acc[m] = ok
    out["diff_768"] = boot(acc["loc"], acc["cloud"])
    return out


def sts():
    rows = jsonl("mteb/stsbenchmark-sts", "test.jsonl.gz")
    s1, s2, g = [r["sentence1"] for r in rows], [r["sentence2"] for r in rows], np.array([r["score"] for r in rows])
    print(f"[stsb] {len(rows)} pairs", flush=True)
    out = {"use_case": "Near-duplicate / similarity scoring", "dataset": "mteb/stsbenchmark-sts", "metric": "Spearman", "pairs": len(rows)}
    sims = {}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        A, _ = embed("sts_a", m, s1, "sts"); B, _ = embed("sts_b", m, s2, "sts")
        for d in (768, 256):
            s = (trunc(A, d) * trunc(B, d)).sum(1)
            out[f"{m}_{d}"] = {"spearman": round(spearmanr(s, g).statistic, 4)}
            if d == 768: sims[m] = s
    r = np.random.default_rng(0); ds = []
    for _ in range(1000):
        i = r.integers(0, len(g), len(g))
        ds.append(spearmanr(sims["cloud"][i], g[i]).statistic - spearmanr(sims["loc"][i], g[i]).statistic)
    out["diff_768"] = (out["cloud_768"]["spearman"] - out["loc_768"]["spearman"], float(np.percentile(ds, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(ds, 97.5)))
    return out


def resume_fit():
    df = pd.read_csv(hf_hub_download("cnamuangtoun/resume-job-description-fit", "test.csv", repo_type="dataset"))
    jds = sorted(df.job_description_text.unique()); jd_i = {j: i for i, j in enumerate(jds)}
    print(f"[resume] {len(df)} resume/job pairs, {len(jds)} unique jobs", flush=True)
    out = {"use_case": "HR: resume vs job description fit", "dataset": "cnamuangtoun/resume-job-description-fit",
           "metric": "ROC-AUC (Good Fit vs No Fit)", "pairs": len(df)}
    keep = df.label.isin(["Good Fit", "No Fit"]).values; y = (df.label == "Good Fit").values[keep]
    sc = {}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        J, _ = embed("hr_jd", m, jds, "query"); R, _ = embed("hr_resume", m, df.resume_text.tolist(), "doc")
        for d in (768, 256):
            s = (trunc(R, d) * trunc(J, d)[[jd_i[j] for j in df.job_description_text]]).sum(1)
            out[f"{m}_{d}"] = {"auc": round(roc_auc_score(y, s[keep]), 4),
                               "spearman_3level": round(spearmanr(s, df.label.map({"No Fit": 0, "Potential Fit": 1, "Good Fit": 2})).statistic, 4)}
            if d == 768: sc[m] = s[keep]
    r = np.random.default_rng(0); ds = []
    for _ in range(1000):
        i = r.integers(0, len(y), len(y))
        if y[i].all() or not y[i].any(): continue
        ds.append(roc_auc_score(y[i], sc["cloud"][i]) - roc_auc_score(y[i], sc["loc"][i]))
    out["diff_768"] = (out["cloud_768"]["auc"] - out["loc_768"]["auc"], float(np.percentile(ds, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(ds, 97.5)))
    return out


def tatoeba():
    out = {"use_case": "Multilingual: match a sentence to its English translation", "dataset": "mteb/tatoeba-bitext-mining",
           "metric": "accuracy (1000 candidates)", "langs": {}}
    allok = {"loc": [], "cloud": []}
    for lang in ("ara", "hin", "mal", "tam", "urd", "fra"):
        rows = jsonl("mteb/tatoeba-bitext-mining", f"test/{lang}-eng.jsonl.gz")
        src, eng = [r["sentence1"].strip() for r in rows], [r["sentence2"].strip() for r in rows]
        res = {"pairs": len(rows)}
        for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
            A, _ = embed(f"tat_{lang}", m, src, "sts"); B, _ = embed(f"tat_{lang}_eng", m, eng, "sts")
            ok = (A @ B.T).argmax(1) == np.arange(len(src))
            res[m] = round(ok.mean(), 4); allok[m].append(ok)
        out["langs"][lang] = res
        print(f"  tatoeba {lang}: local {res['loc']:.3f} cloud {res['cloud']:.3f}", flush=True)
    out["diff_768"] = boot(np.concatenate(allok["loc"]), np.concatenate(allok["cloud"]))
    return out


TASKS = {
    "scifact": lambda: retrieval("sf2", "mteb/scifact", "Science: claim to evidence", max_q=300),
    "nfcorpus": lambda: retrieval("nfcorpus", "mteb/nfcorpus", "Medical: health question to research", max_q=323),
    "fiqa": lambda: retrieval("fiqa", "mteb/fiqa", "Finance: investor question to answer", qkind="qa", max_q=300, max_docs=10000),
    "legal": lambda: retrieval("legal", "mteb/legalbench_consumer_contracts_qa", "Legal: question to contract clause", qkind="qa", max_q=400),
    "stackoverflow": lambda: retrieval("so", "mteb/StackOverflowQA", "Software: dev question to answer", qkind="code", max_q=300, max_docs=8000, parquet_prefix=""),
    "codesearch": lambda: retrieval("csn", "mteb/CodeSearchNetRetrieval", "Software: docstring to Python function", qkind="code", max_q=1000, parquet_prefix="python-"),
    "quora": lambda: retrieval("quora", "mteb/quora", "CRM/tickets: find the duplicate question", max_q=300, max_docs=10000),
    "banking77": banking77, "stsb": sts, "resume": resume_fit, "tatoeba": tatoeba,
}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    res = json.load(open(RES)) if os.path.exists(RES) else {}
    for t in (sys.argv[1:] or TASKS):
        t0 = time.time(); r = TASKS[t](); r["wall_s"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
        res[t] = r; json.dump(res, open(RES, "w"), indent=1, default=float)
        print(json.dumps({t: {k: v for k, v in r.items() if k not in ("langs",)}}, default=float), flush=True)
suite_media.py · 247 lines · Photos, multilingual and spoken photo search, sounds, voice notes, PDF pages, latency
"""Media suite: photos, multilingual + spoken photo search, sounds, speech, PDF pages.
EmbeddingGemma 2 (PyTorch, MPS bf16, local) vs gemini-embedding-2 (cloud). Results -> results/media.json
Usage: .venv/bin/python suite_media.py [task ...]
"""
import io, json, os, random, re, subprocess, sys, time, glob
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, torch
from datasets import load_dataset
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
from google.genai import types
from bench import cloud_embed, norm, trunc, CACHE, load_local
from suite_text import boot

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
RES = os.path.join(HERE, "results", "media.json")
A = os.path.join(HERE, "assets")
_m = {}


def model():
    if "m" not in _m: _m["m"] = load_local()  # full: text + vision + audio
    return _m["m"]


def loc(name, items, prompt=None, bs=8):
    p = os.path.join(CACHE, f"mm_loc_{name}.npy")
    if os.path.exists(p): return np.load(p)
    t = time.time()
    v = model().encode(items, prompt=prompt, batch_size=bs, normalize_embeddings=True, show_progress_bar=False)
    print(f"  local {name}: {len(items)} in {time.time()-t:.1f}s ({len(items)/(time.time()-t):.1f}/s)", flush=True)
    np.save(p, v); return v


def cld(name, items, task):
    p = os.path.join(CACHE, f"mm_cloud_{name}.npy")
    if os.path.exists(p): return np.load(p)
    t = time.time(); v = cloud_embed(items, task, 768)
    print(f"  cloud {name}: {len(items)} in {time.time()-t:.1f}s ({len(items)/(time.time()-t):.1f}/s)", flush=True)
    np.save(p, v); return v


QP, DP = "task: search result | query: ", "title: none | text: "


def jpg(im):
    b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=90); return types.Part.from_bytes(data=b.getvalue(), mime_type="image/jpeg")


def png(path): return types.Part.from_bytes(data=open(path, "rb").read(), mime_type="image/png")


def wav(path): return types.Part.from_bytes(data=open(path, "rb").read(), mime_type="audio/wav")


def ranks(S, gold):
    """1-based rank of the best gold item for each query row. gold: list of sets of column ids."""
    order = np.argsort(-S, axis=1); out = []
    for i, g in enumerate(gold):
        pos = np.where(np.isin(order[i], list(g)))[0]; out.append(int(pos[0]) + 1)
    return np.array(out)


def rk(r): return {"R@1": round(float((r <= 1).mean()), 4), "R@5": round(float((r <= 5).mean()), 4), "R@10": round(float((r <= 10).mean()), 4), "MRR": round(float((1 / r).mean()), 4)}


_flickr = {}


def flickr():
    if not _flickr:
        rows = list(load_dataset("lmms-lab/flickr30k", split="test", streaming=True).take(1000))
        _flickr["imgs"] = [r["image"].convert("RGB") for r in rows]
        _flickr["caps"] = [[c.strip() for c in r["caption"][:5]] for r in rows]
    return _flickr


def photos():
    f = flickr(); imgs, caps = f["imgs"], f["caps"]; n = len(imgs)
    flat = [c for cs in caps for c in cs]; owner = np.repeat(np.arange(n), 5)
    print(f"[photos] {n} images, {len(flat)} caption queries", flush=True)
    E = {"loc": (loc("fl_img", [{"image": im} for im in imgs]), loc("fl_capq", flat, QP, 64), loc("fl_capd", flat, DP, 64)),
         "cloud": (cld("fl_img", [jpg(im) for im in imgs], "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT"), cld("fl_capq", flat, "RETRIEVAL_QUERY"), cld("fl_capd", flat, "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT"))}
    out = {"use_case": "Photo library search (Flickr30k, 1000 photos x 5 human captions)", "images": n, "queries": len(flat)}
    r1 = {}
    for m, (I, Q, Dc) in E.items():
        for d in (768, 256, 128):
            r = ranks(trunc(Q, d) @ trunc(I, d).T, [{o} for o in owner])
            out[f"{m}_t2i_{d}"] = rk(r)
            if d == 768: r1[m] = (r <= 1)
        r = ranks(I @ Dc.T, [set(range(i * 5, i * 5 + 5)) for i in range(n)]); out[f"{m}_i2t_768"] = rk(r)
        # modality bias: 1000 images + caption[0] of each, queried by caption[1] and by image
        cap0 = Dc[0::5]; M = np.vstack([I, cap0]); is_img = np.r_[np.ones(n, bool), np.zeros(n, bool)]
        S = Q[1::5] @ M.T; top = np.argsort(-S, axis=1)[:, :10]
        ri, rc = ranks(S, [{i} for i in range(n)]), ranks(S, [{n + i} for i in range(n)])
        Sx = I @ M.T; Sx[np.arange(n), np.arange(n)] = -9; topx = np.argsort(-Sx, axis=1)[:, :10]
        rcap = ranks(Sx, [{n + i} for i in range(n)])
        out[f"{m}_bias"] = {"text_q_top10_image_share": round(float(is_img[top].mean()), 3),
                            "text_q_median_rank_image": int(np.median(ri)), "text_q_median_rank_caption": int(np.median(rc)),
                            "image_q_top10_image_share": round(float(is_img[topx].mean()), 3),
                            "image_q_median_rank_own_caption": int(np.median(rcap)), "image_q_own_caption_top10": round(float((rcap <= 10).mean()), 3)}
    out["diff_t2i_R@1"] = boot(r1["loc"], r1["cloud"])
    # text-only model (270M) querying the full-model photo index
    from bench import load_local as ll
    mt = ll(vision_config=None, audio_config=None)
    qt = mt.encode(flat[:500], prompt=QP, normalize_embeddings=True, batch_size=64)
    same = (qt * E["loc"][1][:500]).sum(1)
    r = ranks(qt @ E["loc"][0].T, [{o} for o in owner[:500]])
    out["text_only_model"] = {"cosine_vs_full_model_min": round(float(same.min()), 4), "t2i_R@1_first500": rk(r)["R@1"],
                              "full_model_R@1_first500": rk(ranks(E["loc"][1][:500] @ E["loc"][0].T, [{o} for o in owner[:500]]))["R@1"]}
    del mt
    return out


def multilingual_photos():
    f = flickr(); meta = json.load(open(os.path.join(A, "mm_queries.json"))); idx = meta["idx"]; Q = meta["queries"]
    I = {"loc": loc("fl_img", None), "cloud": cld("fl_img", None, None)}
    out = {"use_case": "Photo search in 6 languages, typed and spoken (50 queries each, 1000 photos)", "typed": {}, "spoken": {}}
    for lang in ("en", "de", "es", "hi", "ar", "ml"):
        texts = [q[lang] for q in Q]; res = {}
        for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
            E = loc(f"ml_{lang}", texts, QP, 64) if m == "loc" else cld(f"ml_{lang}", texts, "RETRIEVAL_QUERY")
            res[m] = rk(ranks(E @ I[m].T, [{i} for i in idx]))
        out["typed"][lang] = res; print(f"  typed {lang}: {res['loc']['R@1']} vs {res['cloud']['R@1']}", flush=True)
    for lang, pre in (("en", "q"), ("hi", "hi"), ("ar", "ar")):
        files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(A, "speech", f"{pre}[0-9][0-9].wav"))); res = {}
        for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
            E = loc(f"sp_{lang}", [{"audio": p} for p in files], None, 8) if m == "loc" else cld(f"sp_{lang}", [wav(p) for p in files], "RETRIEVAL_QUERY")
            res[m] = rk(ranks(E @ I[m].T, [{i} for i in idx]))
        out["spoken"][lang] = res; print(f"  spoken {lang}: {res['loc']['R@1']} vs {res['cloud']['R@1']}", flush=True)
    return out


def sounds():
    df = pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(hf_hub_download("ashraq/esc50", f, repo_type="dataset")) for f in
                    ("data/train-00000-of-00002-2f1ab7b824ec751f.parquet", "data/train-00001-of-00002-27425e5c1846b494.parquet")])
    df = df.groupby("category").sample(10, random_state=7).reset_index(drop=True)
    d = os.path.join(A, "esc50"); os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True); files = []
    for i, r in df.iterrows():
        src, dst = os.path.join(d, f"{i}.src.wav"), os.path.join(d, f"{i}.wav"); files.append(dst)
        if not os.path.exists(dst):
            open(src, "wb").write(r["audio"]["bytes"])
            subprocess.run(["afconvert", "-f", "WAVE", "-d", "LEI16@16000", "-c", "1", src, dst], check=True); os.remove(src)
    cats = sorted(df.category.unique()); y = np.array([cats.index(c) for c in df.category])
    labels = [f"the sound of {c.replace('_', ' ')}" for c in cats]
    print(f"[sounds] ESC-50: {len(files)} clips, {len(cats)} classes", flush=True)
    out = {"use_case": "Sound search (ESC-50: 50 everyday sounds, 10 clips each)", "clips": len(files), "classes": len(cats)}
    hit = {}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        X = loc("esc_audio", [{"audio": p} for p in files]) if m == "loc" else cld("esc_audio", [wav(p) for p in files], "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT")
        L = loc("esc_labels", labels, QP, 64) if m == "loc" else cld("esc_labels", labels, "RETRIEVAL_QUERY")
        S = L @ X.T; top = np.argsort(-S, axis=1)
        p1 = np.array([y[top[c, 0]] == c for c in range(len(cats))]); p10 = np.array([(y[top[c, :10]] == c).mean() for c in range(len(cats))])
        zs = (X @ L.T).argmax(1) == y
        out[m] = {"label_to_clip_top1": round(float(p1.mean()), 3), "label_to_clip_P@10": round(float(p10.mean()), 3),
                  "zero_shot_clip_classification": round(float(zs.mean()), 3)}
        hit[m] = zs
        worst = sorted(range(len(cats)), key=lambda c: p10[c])[:5]
        out[m]["weakest_classes"] = [cats[c] for c in worst]
    out["diff_zero_shot"] = boot(hit["loc"], hit["cloud"]); out["chance"] = round(1 / len(cats), 3)
    return out


def speech():
    df = pd.read_parquet(hf_hub_download("hf-internal-testing/librispeech_asr_dummy", "clean/validation-00000-of-00001.parquet", repo_type="dataset"))
    d = os.path.join(A, "libri"); os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True); files = []
    for i, r in df.iterrows():
        src, dst = os.path.join(d, f"{i}.flac"), os.path.join(d, f"{i}.wav"); files.append(dst)
        if not os.path.exists(dst):
            open(src, "wb").write(r["audio"]["bytes"]); subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", src, "-ar", "16000", "-ac", "1", dst], check=True); os.remove(src)
    text = [t.capitalize() for t in df.text]
    print(f"[speech] LibriSpeech: {len(files)} spoken passages", flush=True)
    out = {"use_case": "Voice notes: match a recording to its transcript (LibriSpeech, 73 clips)", "clips": len(files)}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        X = loc("libri_audio", [{"audio": p} for p in files]) if m == "loc" else cld("libri_audio", [wav(p) for p in files], "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT")
        T = loc("libri_text", text, QP, 64) if m == "loc" else cld("libri_text", text, "RETRIEVAL_QUERY")
        g = [{i} for i in range(len(files))]
        out[m] = {"text_to_audio": rk(ranks(T @ X.T, g)), "audio_to_text": rk(ranks(X @ T.T, g))}
    return out


PDF_Q = [  # (query, distinctive phrase on the target page, paper)
    ("diagram of the Transformer encoder-decoder architecture", "Figure 1: The Transformer - model architecture", "attention"),
    ("figure showing scaled dot-product attention and multi-head attention", "Figure 2: (left) Scaled Dot-Product Attention", "attention"),
    ("table comparing complexity per layer of self-attention, recurrent and convolutional layers", "Table 1: Maximum path lengths", "attention"),
    ("BLEU scores and training cost versus earlier translation models", "Table 2: The Transformer achieves better BLEU", "attention"),
    ("ablation table varying the number of attention heads and model size", "Table 3: Variations on the Transformer", "attention"),
    ("English constituency parsing results on WSJ", "Table 4: The Transformer generalizes well", "attention"),
    ("learning rate schedule with warmup steps", "warmup_steps", "attention"),
    ("BERT pre-training and fine-tuning overview diagram", "Figure 1: Overall pre-training and fine-tuning", "bert"),
    ("token, segment and position embeddings input representation", "Figure 2: BERT input representation", "bert"),
    ("GLUE benchmark results table", "Table 1: GLUE Test results", "bert"),
    ("SQuAD question answering results", "Table 2: SQuAD 1.1", "bert"),
    ("effect of model size on fine-tuning accuracy", "Table 6: Ablation over BERT model size", "bert"),
    ("residual learning building block with identity shortcut", "Figure 2. Residual learning: a building block", "resnet"),
    ("training error of 20-layer versus 56-layer plain networks on CIFAR-10", "Figure 1. Training error (left) and test error (right)", "resnet"),
    ("table of ResNet architectures for ImageNet with layer configurations", "Table 1. Architectures for ImageNet", "resnet"),
    ("VGG-19 compared with 34-layer plain and residual network diagrams", "Figure 3. Example network architectures for ImageNet", "resnet"),
    ("CIFAR-10 classification error results", "Table 6. Classification error on the CIFAR-10", "resnet"),
    ("object detection results on COCO", "COCO", "resnet"),
]


def pdf_pages():
    pages, texts = [], []
    for paper in ("attention", "bert", "resnet"):
        for pth in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(A, "pdf", paper, "p-*.png"))):
            n = int(re.search(r"p-(\d+)", pth).group(1)); pages.append((paper, n, pth))
            texts.append(subprocess.run(["pdftotext", "-layout", "-f", str(n), "-l", str(n), os.path.join(A, "pdf", paper + ".pdf"), "-"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)
    norm_t = [re.sub(r"\s+", " ", t).lower() for t in texts]
    qs, gold = [], []
    for q, phrase, paper in PDF_Q:
        g = {i for i, (p, n, _) in enumerate(pages) if p == paper and re.sub(r"\s+", " ", phrase).lower() in norm_t[i]}
        if g: qs.append(q); gold.append(g)
    print(f"[pdf] {len(pages)} page images from 3 papers, {len(qs)} queries with located answers", flush=True)
    out = {"use_case": "Find the right PDF page from page images (3 papers, 43 pages)", "pages": len(pages), "queries": len(qs)}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        P = loc("pdf_pages", [{"image": p} for _, _, p in pages], None, 4) if m == "loc" else cld("pdf_pages", [png(p) for _, _, p in pages], "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT")
        Q = loc("pdf_q", qs, QP, 64) if m == "loc" else cld("pdf_q", qs, "RETRIEVAL_QUERY")
        T = loc("pdf_text", [t[:12000] for t in texts], DP, 8) if m == "loc" else cld("pdf_text", [t[:12000] or "(empty)" for t in texts], "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT")
        out[m] = {"page_image": rk(ranks(Q @ P.T, gold)), "extracted_text": rk(ranks(Q @ T.T, gold))}
    return out


def latency():
    f = flickr(); m = model(); out = {}
    for _ in range(3): m.encode([{"image": f["imgs"][0]}])
    for name, items, mk in (("image_query", f["imgs"][:12], lambda x: {"image": x}),
                            ("audio_query", sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(A, "speech", "q*.wav")))[:12], lambda x: {"audio": x})):
        lt, ct = [], []
        for x in items:
            t = time.perf_counter(); m.encode([mk(x)]); torch.mps.synchronize(); lt.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
        for x in items[:8]:
            part = jpg(x) if name == "image_query" else wav(x)
            t = time.perf_counter(); cloud_embed([part], None, 768); ct.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
        out[name] = {"loc_p50_ms": round(np.median(lt) * 1000), "loc_p95_ms": round(np.percentile(lt, 95) * 1000),
                     "cloud_p50_ms": round(np.median(ct) * 1000), "cloud_p95_ms": round(np.percentile(ct, 95) * 1000)}
        print(f"  {name}: {out[name]}", flush=True)
    return out


TASKS = {"photos": photos, "multilingual_photos": multilingual_photos, "sounds": sounds, "speech": speech, "pdf": pdf_pages, "latency": latency}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    res = json.load(open(RES)) if os.path.exists(RES) else {}
    for t in (sys.argv[1:] or TASKS):
        t0 = time.time(); r = TASKS[t](); r["wall_s"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
        res[t] = r; json.dump(res, open(RES, "w"), indent=1, default=float)
        print(json.dumps({t: r}, default=float)[:1500], flush=True)
suite_more.py · 324 lines · Extended tests: hybrid, clustering, duplicates, calibration, mixed inputs, long documents, baselines, 4-bit/CPU, real voices, video
"""Extension suite: hybrid search, clustering, duplicate thresholds, bias calibration, mixed inputs,
long documents, extra baselines (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, gemini-embedding-001), 4-bit/CPU build, ANN scale,
real speech (FLEURS) and video. Results -> results/more.json.  Usage: suite_more.py [task ...]
"""
import gzip, io, json, os, random, subprocess, sys, time, glob, urllib.request
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
import suite_text as S
from bench import cloud_embed, norm, trunc, CACHE
from suite_text import boot, per_query_ndcg, embed, jsonl

H = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
RES = f"{H}/results/more.json"
A = f"{H}/assets"


# ---------- reproduce suite_text retrieval samples (same RNG call order as the main run)
SPECS = [("codesearch", "csn", "mteb/CodeSearchNetRetrieval", 1000, None, "code", {"parquet_prefix": "python-"}),
         ("nfcorpus", "nfcorpus", "mteb/nfcorpus", 323, None, "query", {}),
         ("scifact", "sf2", "mteb/scifact", 300, None, "query", {}),
         ("quora", "quora", "mteb/quora", 300, 10000, "query", {}),
         ("stackoverflow", "so", "mteb/StackOverflowQA", 300, 8000, "code", {"parquet_prefix": ""}),
         ("fiqa", "fiqa", "mteb/fiqa", 300, 10000, "qa", {}),
         ("legal", "legal", "mteb/legalbench_consumer_contracts_qa", 400, None, "qa", {})]
_samples = {}


def samples():
    if _samples: return _samples
    for key, name, repo, max_q, max_docs, qkind, kw in SPECS:
        if key == "legal": S.rng.seed(7)
        corpus, queries, qrels = S.load_beir(repo, **kw)
        qids = sorted(q for q in qrels if q in queries); S.rng.shuffle(qids); qids = sorted(qids[:max_q])
        if max_docs and len(corpus) > max_docs:
            keep = {d for q in qids for d in qrels[q] if d in corpus}
            rest = [d for d in corpus if d not in keep]; S.rng.shuffle(rest); keep |= set(rest[:max_docs - len(keep)])
            corpus = {d: corpus[d] for d in sorted(keep)}
        qrels = {q: {d for d in qrels[q] if d in corpus} for q in qids}; qids = [q for q in qids if qrels[q]]
        _samples[key] = dict(name=name, corpus=corpus, queries=queries, qrels=qrels, qids=qids, dids=list(corpus), qkind=qkind)
    return _samples


def bm25_rank(sm, k=100):
    import bm25s, Stemmer
    st = Stemmer.Stemmer("english"); r = bm25s.BM25()
    r.index(bm25s.tokenize([sm["corpus"][d][:S.MAXCH] for d in sm["dids"]], stopwords="en", stemmer=st, show_progress=False), show_progress=False)
    res, _ = r.retrieve(bm25s.tokenize([sm["queries"][q] for q in sm["qids"]], stopwords="en", stemmer=st, show_progress=False), k=k, show_progress=False)
    return res


def ndcg_from_ranking(rank, sm):
    out = []
    for i, q in enumerate(sm["qids"]):
        rel = sm["qrels"][q]; hits = [sm["dids"][j] in rel for j in rank[i][:10]]
        dcg = sum(1 / np.log2(k + 2) for k, h in enumerate(hits) if h); idcg = sum(1 / np.log2(k + 2) for k in range(min(len(rel), 10)))
        out.append(dcg / idcg)
    return np.array(out)


def hybrid():
    out = {}
    for key, sm in samples().items():
        bm = bm25_rank(sm); res = {"bm25": float(ndcg_from_ranking(bm, sm).mean())}
        for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
            Q = trunc(np.load(f"{CACHE}/{m}_{sm['name']}_q.npy"), 768); D = trunc(np.load(f"{CACHE}/{m}_{sm['name']}_docs.npy"), 768)
            dense = np.argsort(-(Q @ D.T), axis=1)[:, :100]
            fused = []
            for i in range(len(sm["qids"])):  # reciprocal rank fusion, k=60
                sc = {}
                for r, j in enumerate(dense[i]): sc[j] = sc.get(j, 0) + 1 / (60 + r + 1)
                for r, j in enumerate(bm[i]): sc[j] = sc.get(j, 0) + 1 / (60 + r + 1)
                fused.append(sorted(sc, key=lambda j: -sc[j])[:10])
            nd_d, nd_h = ndcg_from_ranking(dense, sm), ndcg_from_ranking(fused, sm)
            res[m] = float(nd_d.mean()); res[m + "_hybrid"] = float(nd_h.mean()); res[m + "_hybrid_diff"] = boot(nd_d, nd_h)
        out[key] = res; print(key, {k: (round(v, 4) if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k, v in res.items() if not k.endswith("diff")}, flush=True)
    return out


def baselines():
    """Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (llama.cpp, port 8091) and gemini-embedding-001 on the same samples + Tatoeba."""
    out = {}
    for key, sm in samples().items():
        res = {}
        for m in ("qwen", "g1"):
            D, _ = embed(f"{sm['name']}_docs", m, [sm["corpus"][d] for d in sm["dids"]], "doc")
            Q, _ = embed(f"{sm['name']}_q", m, [sm["queries"][q] for q in sm["qids"]], sm["qkind"])
            nd, _, _ = per_query_ndcg(trunc(Q, 768) if Q.shape[1] > 768 else Q, trunc(D, 768) if D.shape[1] > 768 else D, sm["qids"], sm["dids"], sm["qrels"])
            res[m] = float(nd.mean())

                nd3, _, _ = per_query_ndcg(Q, D, sm["qids"], sm["dids"], sm["qrels"]); res["g1_3072"] = float(nd3.mean())
        out[key] = res; print(key, res, flush=True)

def clustering():
    from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
    from sklearn.metrics import v_measure_score
    te = S.pq("mteb/banking77", "data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet").sample(1000, random_state=7)
    y = te.label.values; out = {"dataset": "banking77 test, 1000 tickets, 77 intents", "metric": "V-measure (KMeans, k=77, 5 seeds)"}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        X = np.load(f"{CACHE}/{m}_b77_test.npy")
        for d in (768, 256):
            vs = [v_measure_score(y, KMeans(77, n_init=4, random_state=s).fit_predict(trunc(X, d))) for s in range(5)]
            out[f"{m}_{d}"] = {"v_measure": float(np.mean(vs)), "sd": float(np.std(vs))}
    print(out, flush=True); return out


def dedupe_threshold():
    from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score, precision_recall_curve
    p = hf_hub_download("mteb/sprintduplicatequestions-pairclassification", "test.json.gz", repo_type="dataset")
    rec = json.load(gzip.open(p, "rt")); rec = rec[0] if isinstance(rec, list) else rec
    s1, s2, lab = rec["sent1"], rec["sent2"], rec["labels"]
    if isinstance(s1[0], list): s1, s2, lab = s1[0], s2[0], lab[0]
    lab = np.array(lab); r = np.random.default_rng(7)  # all duplicates + 4,000 random non-duplicates
    keep = np.r_[np.where(lab == 1)[0], r.choice(np.where(lab == 0)[0], 4000, replace=False)]; keep.sort()
    s1, s2, lab = [s1[i] for i in keep], [s2[i] for i in keep], lab[keep]
    out = {"dataset": f"Sprint duplicate questions ({len(lab)} pairs, {int(lab.sum())} duplicates)", "metric": "average precision; best-F1 cosine threshold"}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        Aa, _ = embed("sprint_a", m, s1, "sts"); Bb, _ = embed("sprint_b", m, s2, "sts")
        sc = (Aa * Bb).sum(1); pr, rc, th = precision_recall_curve(lab, sc)
        f1 = 2 * pr * rc / np.maximum(pr + rc, 1e-9); i = int(np.argmax(f1[:-1]))
        out[m] = {"ap": float(average_precision_score(lab, sc)), "best_f1": float(f1[i]), "threshold": float(th[i]),
                  "precision": float(pr[i]), "recall": float(rc[i]),
                  "dup_cos_median": float(np.median(sc[lab == 1])), "nondup_cos_median": float(np.median(sc[lab == 0]))}
    print(out, flush=True); return out


def calibration():
    """Per-modality score standardisation on the mixed photo+caption index."""
    out = {}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        I = np.load(f"{CACHE}/mm_{m}_fl_img.npy"); Dc = np.load(f"{CACHE}/mm_{m}_fl_capd.npy"); Q = np.load(f"{CACHE}/mm_{m}_fl_capq.npy")
        n = len(I); cap0 = Dc[0::5]; M = np.vstack([I, cap0]); is_img = np.r_[np.ones(n, bool), np.zeros(n, bool)]
        res = {}
        for qname, QQ, drop_self in (("text_query", Q[1::5], False), ("photo_query", I, True)):
            Sraw = QQ @ M.T
            if drop_self: Sraw[np.arange(n), np.arange(n)] = np.nan
            Sz = Sraw.copy()
            for grp in (is_img, ~is_img):  # z-score each query's scores within each file type
                g = Sz[:, grp]; Sz[:, grp] = (g - np.nanmean(g, 1, keepdims=True)) / np.nanstd(g, 1, keepdims=True)
            for tag, SS in (("raw", Sraw), ("calibrated", Sz)):
                SS = np.nan_to_num(SS, nan=-9); top = np.argsort(-SS, axis=1)[:, :10]
                gold = [{n + i} if drop_self else {i, n + i} for i in range(n)]
                hit1 = np.mean([top[i, 0] in gold[i] for i in range(n)]); hit10 = np.mean([bool(set(top[i]) & gold[i]) for i in range(n)])
                res[f"{qname}_{tag}"] = {"top10_image_share": float(is_img[top].mean()), "R@1": float(hit1), "R@10": float(hit10)}
        out[m] = res; print(m, res, flush=True)
    out["note"] = "text query: either the photo or its caption counts as correct; photo query: its own caption is the target"
    return out


def mixed_input():
    from suite_media import flickr, model, jpg
    from google.genai import types
    f = flickr(); imgs, caps = f["imgs"], f["caps"]; n = len(imgs)
    out = {"dataset": "1000 Flickr30k photos; document = photo + one caption in ONE vector; query = a different caption"}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        p = f"{CACHE}/mm_{m}_fl_mixed.npy"
        if os.path.exists(p): X = np.load(p)
        elif m == "loc":
            X = model().encode([{"text": f"title: none | text: <|image|> {caps[i][0]}", "image": imgs[i]} for i in range(n)], batch_size=8, normalize_embeddings=True, show_progress_bar=False); np.save(p, X)
        else:
            def gen():
                cfg = types.EmbedContentConfig(task_type="RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT", output_dimensionality=768); vs = []
                for i0 in range(0, n, 50):
                    r = S.cloud_embed.__globals__["gc"].models.embed_content(model="gemini-embedding-2", config=cfg,
                        contents=[types.Content(parts=[jpg(imgs[i]), types.Part(text=caps[i][0])]) for i in range(i0, min(n, i0 + 50))])
                    vs += [e.values for e in r.embeddings]
                return norm(np.array(vs, np.float32))
            X = gen(); np.save(p, X)
        Q = np.load(f"{CACHE}/mm_{m}_fl_capq.npy")[1::5]
        I = np.load(f"{CACHE}/mm_{m}_fl_img.npy"); C = np.load(f"{CACHE}/mm_{m}_fl_capd.npy")[0::5]
        def r1(D): return float(((Q @ D.T).argmax(1) == np.arange(n)).mean())
        out[m] = {"photo_only": r1(I), "caption_only": r1(C), "photo_plus_caption": r1(X)}
        print(m, out[m], flush=True)
    return out


def long_docs():
    """SciFact: hide the relevant abstract inside a ~5-abstract document at start / middle / end."""
    sm = samples()["scifact"]; rr = random.Random(3)
    rel = sorted({d for q in sm["qids"] for d in sm["qrels"][q]})
    others = [d for d in sm["dids"] if d not in set(rel)]; rr.shuffle(others)
    base = rel + others[:1000 - len(rel)]; filler = others[1000:]
    out = {"dataset": f"SciFact, {len(sm['qids'])} queries, 1000 documents of ~5 abstracts (~1,500-2,000 tokens)"}
    for pos in ("short", "start", "middle", "end"):
        docs = []
        for i, d in enumerate(base):
            fill = [sm["corpus"][filler[(i * 4 + k) % len(filler)]] for k in range(4)]
            body = {"short": [sm["corpus"][d]], "start": [sm["corpus"][d]] + fill, "middle": fill[:2] + [sm["corpus"][d]] + fill[2:], "end": fill + [sm["corpus"][d]]}[pos]
            docs.append("\n\n".join(body))
        res = {}
        for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
            D, _ = embed(f"long_{pos}_docs", m, docs, "doc"); Q = np.load(f"{CACHE}/{m}_sf2_q.npy")
            nd, _, _ = per_query_ndcg(trunc(Q, 768), trunc(D, 768), sm["qids"], base, sm["qrels"]); res[m] = float(nd.mean())
        out[pos] = res; print(pos, res, flush=True)
    return out


def q4_cpu():
    """4-bit (UD-Q4_K_XL) build on GPU for quality; Q4 on 4 CPU threads for phone-like latency."""
    srv = f"{H}/llamacpp/llama-b11541/llama-server"; out = {}
    def start(model, port, gpu, threads=None):
        args = [srv, "-m", f"{H}/gguf/{model}", "--embedding", "-ngl", "99" if gpu else "0", "-c", "32768", "-np", "4", "-b", "8192", "-ub", "8192", "--port", str(port), "--host", "127.0.0.1"]
        if threads: args += ["-t", str(threads)]
        p = subprocess.Popen(args, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                if b"ok" in urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health").read(): break
            except Exception: time.sleep(1)
        return p
    p = start("embeddinggemma-2-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf", 8092, True)
    url = "http://127.0.0.1:8092/v1/embeddings"
    for key in ("scifact", "legal"):
        sm = samples()[key]
        D = S.local_embed([S.P_LOCAL["doc"] + sm["corpus"][d][:S.MAXCH] for d in sm["dids"]], url)
        Q = S.local_embed([S.P_LOCAL[sm["qkind"]] + sm["queries"][q] for q in sm["qids"]], url)
        nd, _, _ = per_query_ndcg(Q, D, sm["qids"], sm["dids"], sm["qrels"]); out[f"q4_{key}"] = float(nd.mean())
        print("q4", key, out[f"q4_{key}"], flush=True)
    p.terminate(); p.wait()
    sm = samples()["scifact"]; qs = [S.P_LOCAL["query"] + sm["queries"][q] for q in sm["qids"][:40]]
    for model, tag in (("embeddinggemma-2-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf", "q4"), ("embeddinggemma-2-Q8_0.gguf", "q8")):
        p = start(model, 8093, False, 4)
        for q in qs[:5]: S.local_embed([q], "http://127.0.0.1:8093/v1/embeddings")
        lat = []
        for q in qs:
            t = time.perf_counter(); S.local_embed([q], "http://127.0.0.1:8093/v1/embeddings"); lat.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
        out[f"cpu4_{tag}_p50_ms"] = float(np.median(lat) * 1000); out[f"cpu4_{tag}_p95_ms"] = float(np.percentile(lat, 95) * 1000)
        print(tag, "cpu 4 threads", out[f"cpu4_{tag}_p50_ms"], flush=True)
        p.terminate(); p.wait()
    out["sizes_mb"] = {f: round(os.path.getsize(f"{H}/gguf/{f}") / 1e6) for f in os.listdir(f"{H}/gguf") if f.endswith(".gguf")}
    return out


def ann_scale():
    import faiss
    out = {}; rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    for d in (768, 256):
        X = rng.standard_normal((1_000_000, d), dtype=np.float32); faiss.normalize_L2(X)
        q = X[rng.integers(0, len(X), 200)] + 0.05 * rng.standard_normal((200, d), dtype=np.float32); faiss.normalize_L2(q)
        flat = faiss.IndexFlatIP(d); flat.add(X)
        t = time.perf_counter(); flat.search(q[:50], 10); flat_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t) / 50 * 1000
        t = time.perf_counter(); hn = faiss.IndexHNSWFlat(d, 32, faiss.METRIC_INNER_PRODUCT); hn.hnsw.efConstruction = 80; hn.add(X); build = time.perf_counter() - t
        hn.hnsw.efSearch = 64; _, gt = flat.search(q, 10)
        t = time.perf_counter(); _, I = hn.search(q, 10); hn_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t) / len(q) * 1000
        rec = float(np.mean([len(set(I[i]) & set(gt[i])) / 10 for i in range(len(q))]))
        out[f"{d}d"] = {"vectors": 1_000_000, "memory_gb": round(X.nbytes / 2**30, 2), "brute_force_ms_per_query": round(flat_ms, 1),
                        "hnsw_build_s": round(build, 1), "hnsw_ms_per_query": round(hn_ms, 2), "hnsw_recall@10": round(rec, 3)}
        print(d, out[f"{d}d"], flush=True); del X, flat, hn
    return out


def fleurs(n=150):
    """Real human read speech (FLEURS): speech -> own transcript, and speech -> English translation."""
    from suite_media import loc as mloc, cld as mcld, wav
    import soundfile as sf
    langs = {"en_us": "English", "hi_in": "Hindi", "ar_eg": "Arabic", "ml_in": "Malayalam"}
    dfs = {c: pd.read_parquet(f"{A}/fleurs/{c}/test/0000.parquet") for c in langs}
    for c in dfs: dfs[c] = dfs[c].drop_duplicates("id").set_index("id")
    common = sorted(set.intersection(*[set(d.index) for d in dfs.values()]))[:n]
    eng = [dfs["en_us"].loc[i, "transcription"] for i in common]
    out = {"dataset": f"FLEURS test, {len(common)} sentences read aloud by real speakers in each language"}
    for c, name in langs.items():
        d = f"{A}/fleurs/wav_{c}"; os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True); files = []
        for i in common:
            fp = f"{d}/{i}.wav"; files.append(fp)
            if not os.path.exists(fp):
                a = dfs[c].loc[i, "audio"]; data, sr = sf.read(io.BytesIO(a["bytes"]))
                tmp = fp + ".src.wav"; sf.write(tmp, data, sr)
                subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", tmp, "-ar", "16000", "-ac", "1", fp], check=True); os.remove(tmp)
        own = [dfs[c].loc[i, "transcription"] for i in common]; res = {}
        for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
            X = mloc(f"fl_{c}_audio", [{"audio": p} for p in files]) if m == "loc" else mcld(f"fl_{c}_audio", [wav(p) for p in files], "RETRIEVAL_QUERY")
            T = mloc(f"fl_{c}_text", own, "title: none | text: ", 64) if m == "loc" else mcld(f"fl_{c}_text", own, "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT")
            E = mloc("fl_eng_text", eng, "title: none | text: ", 64) if m == "loc" else mcld("fl_eng_text", eng, "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT")
            g = np.arange(len(common))
            res[m] = {"speech_to_own_transcript_R@1": float(((X @ T.T).argmax(1) == g).mean()),
                      "speech_to_english_R@1": float(((X @ E.T).argmax(1) == g).mean())}
        out[name] = res; print(name, res, flush=True)
    return out


VIDEO_Q = json.load(open(f"{A}/video/queries.json")) if os.path.exists(f"{A}/video/queries.json") else []


def video():
    from suite_media import loc as mloc, cld as mcld
    from google.genai import types
    clips = sorted(glob.glob(f"{A}/video/clips/c*.mp4"))
    qs = [q["q"] for q in VIDEO_Q]; gold = [set(q["clips"]) for q in VIDEO_Q]
    out = {"dataset": f"Big Buck Bunny (CC-BY Blender Foundation), first {len(clips)*5} s cut into {len(clips)} five-second clips; {len(qs)} hand-labelled queries"}
    for m in ("loc", "cloud"):
        if m == "loc":
            from PIL import Image  # 1 fps frames, the model's default video sampling (torchcodec unavailable here)
            fr = lambda p: [Image.open(x).convert("RGB") for x in sorted(glob.glob(p.replace("/clips/", "/f1/")[:-4] + "/*.jpg"), key=lambda x: int(os.path.basename(x)[:-4]))]
            V = mloc("video_clips", [{"video": fr(p)} for p in clips], None, 2); Q = mloc("video_q", qs, "task: search result | query: ", 32)
        else:
            V = mcld("video_clips", [types.Part.from_bytes(data=open(p, "rb").read(), mime_type="video/mp4") for p in clips], "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT")
            Q = mcld("video_q", qs, "RETRIEVAL_QUERY")
        top = np.argsort(-(Q @ V.T), axis=1)
        r1 = np.mean([top[i, 0] in gold[i] for i in range(len(qs))]); r3 = np.mean([bool(set(top[i, :3]) & gold[i]) for i in range(len(qs))])
        out[m] = {"R@1": float(r1), "R@3": float(r3)}; print(m, out[m], flush=True)
    return out


TASKS = {"hybrid": hybrid, "clustering": clustering, "dedupe": dedupe_threshold, "calibration": calibration,

"""BM25 keyword-search baseline on the exact same samples as suite_text.py (reproduces its RNG order)."""
import json, os, numpy as np, bm25s, Stemmer
import suite_text as S

def run(name, repo, max_q, max_docs=None, **kw):
    corpus, queries, qrels = S.load_beir(repo, **kw)
    qids = sorted(q for q in qrels if q in queries); S.rng.shuffle(qids); qids = sorted(qids[:max_q])
    if max_docs and len(corpus) > max_docs:
        keep = {d for q in qids for d in qrels[q] if d in corpus}
        rest = [d for d in corpus if d not in keep]; S.rng.shuffle(rest); keep |= set(rest[:max_docs - len(keep)])
        corpus = {d: corpus[d] for d in sorted(keep)}
    qrels = {q: {d for d in qrels[q] if d in corpus} for q in qids}; qids = [q for q in qids if qrels[q]]
    dids = list(corpus); st = Stemmer.Stemmer("english")
    r = bm25s.BM25(); r.index(bm25s.tokenize([corpus[d][:S.MAXCH] for d in dids], stopwords="en", stemmer=st, show_progress=False), show_progress=False)
    res, _ = r.retrieve(bm25s.tokenize([queries[q] for q in qids], stopwords="en", stemmer=st, show_progress=False), k=10, show_progress=False)
    nd = []
    for i, q in enumerate(qids):
        hits = [dids[j] in qrels[q] for j in res[i]]
        dcg = sum(1/np.log2(k+2) for k, h in enumerate(hits) if h); idcg = sum(1/np.log2(k+2) for k in range(min(len(qrels[q]), 10)))
        nd.append(dcg/idcg)
    print(name, len(dids), len(qids), round(float(np.mean(nd)), 4), flush=True)
    return round(float(np.mean(nd)), 4)

out = {}
# same call order as the main run: codesearch, nfcorpus, scifact, quora, stackoverflow, fiqa
out["codesearch"] = run("csn", "mteb/CodeSearchNetRetrieval", 1000, parquet_prefix="python-")
out["nfcorpus"] = run("nfcorpus", "mteb/nfcorpus", 323)
out["scifact"] = run("sf2", "mteb/scifact", 300)
out["quora"] = run("quora", "mteb/quora", 300, 10000)
out["stackoverflow"] = run("so", "mteb/StackOverflowQA", 300, 8000, parquet_prefix="")
out["fiqa"] = run("fiqa", "mteb/fiqa", 300, 10000)
S.rng.seed(7)  # legal ran first in its own process
out["legal"] = run("legal", "mteb/legalbench_consumer_contracts_qa", 400)
json.dump(out, open("results/bm25.json", "w"), indent=1)

"""Text query latency + throughput at concurrency 1/4/16: llama.cpp Q8_0 vs gemini-embedding-2. -> results/llamacpp.json"""
import json, time, urllib.request, numpy as np
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from datasets import load_dataset
from bench import cloud_embed
U = "http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/embeddings"
def loc(texts):
    r = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(U, json.dumps({"input": texts}).encode(), {"content-type": "application/json"}))
    return json.load(r)
c = load_dataset("mteb/scifact", "corpus")["corpus"]
docs = [f"title: {t} | text: {x}" for t, x in zip(c["title"][:800], c["text"][:800])]
qs = ["task: search result | query: " + q for q in load_dataset("mteb/scifact", "queries")["queries"]["text"][:200]]
out = {}
for _ in range(5): loc(qs[:4])
lat = []
for q in qs[:60]:
    t = time.perf_counter(); loc([q]); lat.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
out["text_p50_loc"], out["text_p95_loc"] = float(np.median(lat) * 1000), float(np.percentile(lat, 95) * 1000)
lat = []
for q in qs[:30]:
    t = time.perf_counter(); cloud_embed([q[30:]], "RETRIEVAL_QUERY", 768); lat.append(time.perf_counter() - t)
out["text_p50_cloud"], out["text_p95_cloud"] = float(np.median(lat) * 1000), float(np.percentile(lat, 95) * 1000)
for conc in (1, 4, 16):
    t = time.perf_counter()
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(conc) as ex: list(ex.map(lambda q: loc([q]), qs[:160]))
    out[f"qps_loc_c{conc}"] = 160 / (time.perf_counter() - t)
    t = time.perf_counter()
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(conc) as ex: list(ex.map(lambda q: cloud_embed([q[30:]], "RETRIEVAL_QUERY", 768), qs[:80]))
    out[f"qps_cloud_c{conc}"] = 80 / (time.perf_counter() - t)
    print(conc, round(out[f"qps_loc_c{conc}"], 1), round(out[f"qps_cloud_c{conc}"], 1), flush=True)
t = time.perf_counter()
with ThreadPoolExecutor(4) as ex: list(ex.map(loc, [docs[i:i+16] for i in range(0, 800, 16)]))
out["index_docs_per_s_loc"] = 800 / (time.perf_counter() - t)
t = time.perf_counter(); cloud_embed([d[22:] for d in docs], "RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT", 768)
out["index_docs_per_s_cloud"] = 800 / (time.perf_counter() - t)
import subprocess; out["load_avg"] = subprocess.run(["sysctl", "-n", "vm.loadavg"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
json.dump(out, open("results/llamacpp.json", "w"), indent=1); print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
ann_scale.py · 16 lines · Exact and HNSW search speed at 1M vectors
"""Search speed at 1M vectors (FAISS brute force vs HNSW). Runs without torch to avoid OpenMP clashes."""
import json, os, time, numpy as np, faiss
out = {}; rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
for d in (768, 256):
    X = rng.standard_normal((1_000_000, d), dtype=np.float32); faiss.normalize_L2(X)
    q = X[rng.integers(0, len(X), 200)] + 0.05 * rng.standard_normal((200, d), dtype=np.float32); faiss.normalize_L2(q)
    flat = faiss.IndexFlatIP(d); flat.add(X)
    t = time.perf_counter(); flat.search(q[:50], 10); flat_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t) / 50 * 1000
    t = time.perf_counter(); hn = faiss.IndexHNSWFlat(d, 32, faiss.METRIC_INNER_PRODUCT); hn.hnsw.efConstruction = 80; hn.add(X); build = time.perf_counter() - t
    hn.hnsw.efSearch = 64; _, gt = flat.search(q, 10)
    t = time.perf_counter(); _, I = hn.search(q, 10); hn_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t) / len(q) * 1000
    rec = float(np.mean([len(set(I[i]) & set(gt[i])) / 10 for i in range(len(q))]))
    out[f"{d}d"] = {"vectors": 1_000_000, "memory_gb": round(X.nbytes / 2**30, 2), "brute_force_ms_per_query": round(flat_ms, 1),
                    "hnsw_build_s": round(build, 1), "hnsw_ms_per_query": round(hn_ms, 2), "hnsw_recall@10": round(rec, 3)}
    print(d, out[f"{d}d"], flush=True); del X, flat, hn
p = "results/more.json"; r = json.load(open(p)); r["ann_scale"] = out; json.dump(r, open(p, "w"), indent=1)
